name: Topologically Correct Marching Cubes
definition: An extension to Marching Cubes that provides additional guarantees for the output, generating a mesh homeomorphic to the trilinear interpolant of the input value field inside each cube.
summary: Topologically Correct Marching Cubes is an algorithm that resolves ambiguous configurations by inserting vertices to guarantee a mesh homeomorphic to the trilinear interpolant.
